seo.title: For clients: paying a freelancer in Brazil | Travessia
seo.description: Your freelancer sends an invoice in English, in your currency. You pay by card or local bank transfer, like any other supplier. No account needed.

hero.title: Paying a freelancer in Brazil, the simple way
hero.lead: Your freelancer sends an invoice in English, in your currency. You pay by card or local bank transfer, like any other supplier.

items.title: You get an email
items.detail: With the invoice as a PDF and a secure link. No account, no app.

items.title: You pay the way you already do
items.detail: Card, or a local transfer in USD, EUR or GBP to an account in your region.

items.title: You get a receipt
items.detail: A paid receipt for your books, in English, the moment the payment clears.

panels.title: Ways to pay
items: Credit or debit card, in your currency
Local bank transfer in the US, UK and eurozone
The freelancer covers the fees; you pay the invoice total

panels.title: What your finance team gets
items: An invoice with the freelancer's legal name and tax ID in Brazil
A paid receipt matching the invoice number
Payments processed by licensed partners, never through the freelancer's personal account

faq.title: Questions from finance teams
faq.lead: Something missing? Your freelancer can forward your question to us.
